2 finding(s): 1 to fix, 1 to consider; 2 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

The geometry change from a square side to a width × height box is applied consistently across the recorder bubble, the overlay placeholder, the editor preview, the clip path, the drag clamp, the preset centres and the export composer. Older settings, sidecars and sessions fall back to the 18 % corner they had before. All callers of the changed functions (`clampWebcamCenter`, `webcamClipPath`, `webcamPresetCenter`, `cameraPreviewPlacement`) were updated. I found two issues. ADR 0041 says shape and corner radius are never set per section, but the inspector and the session format let an override carry both (fix, docs). The corner-radius snap also divides by a hardcoded 100 instead of using the step constant (consider).

> ℹ️ No critical issues. One rough edge inline. **Reviewed changes** The full initial diff: the new `rectangle` shape and `cornerRadius` field, carried from settings through the recorder bubble, the overlay placeholder, the sidecar, the editor layer, the inspector and the MP4/GIF composer. - **Shared geometry**: `cameraShapeAspect`, `cameraBubbleBox`, `cameraCornerRadiusPx` and `clampCameraCornerRadius` in `shared/camera-bubble.ts` are now the one source for the aspect and the corner. `sanitizeCameraBubble` reads a missing radius as 0.18. - **Recorder bubble**: the window stays square. The rectangle and its chrome are centred through a `--inset-x` CSS variable, and the corner comes from settings. - **Overlay placeholder**: `cameraPreviewPlacement` and `CameraPreview` draw the same box and corner as the bubble will. - **Sidecar**: `recordedLayout` carries `cornerRadius`. It reaches `withRecordedBubble` through the `{ deviceId, ...bubble }` spread in `use-recording-setup.ts`. - **Editor geometry**: `WebcamRect` is now `{ x, y, width, height }`. `clampWebcamCenter` and `webcamPresetCenter` clamp each axis by its own side. The clip path keeps a rectangle's corners circular with `inset(0 round h% / v%)`. `webcamSourceRect` takes the box's aspect, so the export draws the same window that `object-fit: cover` shows. - **Session and model**: the parser accepts `rectangle` and `cornerRadius`, and old sessions get 0.18. `seedWebcamScene` clamps the recorded radius. - **Inspector and settings UI**: there are three shape chips. A Corners slider shows for Square and Rectangle: history-aware in the editor, live in the camera drawer. - **Docs and i18n**: this adds ADR 0041, updates the backlog page, and adds the en/es labels ("Rounded" becomes "Square").   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/475?action=fix&review_id=5724946074) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/475?action=fix-approved&review_id=5724946074) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41242202192/job/124658229241) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)

> ✅ No new issues found. The prior feedback is addressed cleanly. **Reviewed changes** What changed in 1bcab52 since the last Pullfrog review: - **Shape change keeps the preset snap**: `changeShape` in `webcam-inspector.tsx` uses the same `near` test as the preset buttons to find the matching preset, then commits `{ shape, position }` together, so one undo restores both. A bubble placed by hand keeps its centre. Two new inspector tests cover each case. - **Corner snap uses the step constant**: `clampCameraCornerRadius` now multiplies by `CAMERA_CORNER_RADIUS_STEP` and then rounds to two decimals to remove float noise. The new test pins `0.07`. - **ADR 0041 wording**: the ADR now says that an override segment can carry `shape` and `cornerRadius` today, and that ADR 0039's sections will drop both once they land. This matches what the inspector and the session parser actually do.   ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41243142129/job/124660988502) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)

## Follow-up Comments
Cap the rectangle before calculating preset centers.
`185-196`: ** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Cap the rectangle before calculating preset centers.** For a reachable large rectangle on a narrow frame, `webcamPresetCenter` uses a different box from `webcamRect`. A corner preset can therefore render with an incorrect edge margin.
Suggested fix
```diff - const height = size * frame.height; - const width = height * cameraShapeAspect(shape); + const aspect = cameraShapeAspect(shape); + const height = Math.min(size * frame.height, frame.width / aspect, frame.height); + const width = height * aspect; ```
[Open the source location](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/blob/084f6f8a04f593b0dbb706f9caf906d5e293e4f2/apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/webcam/webcam-layout.ts#L185-L196)
